subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the generated-doc gap, while two open contributor PRs attempt overlapping fixes with different implementation and proof signals.

options.title: Refresh the stronger proven PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable refreshing it on current main and rerunning proof.

options.title: Repair the same-author PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 if maintainers prefer the issue author's smaller branch after proof and implementation gaps are addressed.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Close or pause both competing branches and ask for one narrow replacement PR if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh the stronger proven PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable refreshing it on current main and rerunning proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent SecretRef credential matrix docs history and is the best available routing owner for choosing the implementation path.
